answer_1.quote: We propose a conversational query rewriter to transform the ad‑hoc queries in the graph into conversational natural language‑based ones. Our conversational query rewriter is composed of two T5 models (NL‑T5 and CNL‑T5).
answer_1.outputs: Conversational natural language queries (CNL‑based) generated from keyword‑based ad‑hoc queries, used to build pseudo conversational search sessions

answer_2.quote: We conduct experiments on two widely used conversational search evaluation datasets... Using MRR, NDCG@3, and Recall (at cutoff 20 and 100) as the evaluation metrics.
